official_reference: scripts/train_may.sh and nerf_triplane/{utils,provider}.py at the pinned commit
new_identity_definition: not May, never used to train a SyncTalk identity model in these gain experiments; wider project/upstream exposure audited and reported separately
language: English; retained from May to avoid adding language as another factor
source_policy: natural HDTF sources with official original-video URL and timestamps; pinned mirror only as transport; no synthetic supervision
recording_separation: all test frames/audio MUST come from a distinct original recording from every train/validation source; distinct upload ID alone is insufficient; footage/PCM duplicate and visual/context audit required
context: at least one second of audio context outside each supervision block, two-second gap between same-recording training/validation support blocks; no concatenation of audio contexts across recordings

test_clips.selection: frozen contiguous segments before training; no score-based exclusions

initialization: one complete random NeRF/condition-module initial state per identity/seed, strict identical load in three arms; no pretrained identity generator; frozen original AVE pretrained weights

fine.resume: own arm's final full coarse checkpoint, including optimizer/scheduler/scaler/EMA/epoch/global_step

official_budget_semantics: official train() iterates whole epochs; --iters 100000 is cumulative after checkpoint resume, not 100000 extra updates. With 6000 training frames: 10 coarse epochs=60000 attempted steps; final 17 epochs=102000 cumulative attempted steps, fine adds 42000. Exact dataset length must be verified before admission.
precision: official -O autocast FP16; log actual AdamW updates and AMP skipped updates, not just global_step. Equal successful-update budget is an admission requirement; unequal skips invalidate a paired block. No silent FP32 or ray reduction fallback.
randomness: per-step deterministic RNG domains for image order, actual ray/patch/rectangle sampling, occupancy and perturbation; record actual sampled-index digests; validation must not alter training RNG
official_loss: unchanged official train_step; retain official alternating lip/full-patch behavior, LPIPS weight and defaults, LR schedules and EMA semantics
preprocessing_contract: preprocessing_contract_v2.json; ADR039 shared fixed training-reference points, original training BA unchanged; ADR038 identity/focal/background/lazy loading retained; v1 gauge failure preserved
loading: official --preload 0 after exact pixel/ray-input parity to --preload 1 on shared subset; avoids 44.04GB minimum float32 resident preload, without changing rays/precision/epochs or model updates
preprocessing: official face parsing, 68-point landmarks, Basel 3DMM tracking, pose refinement, masks/torso/background and eye coefficients; identity/background/intrinsic fitting must not leak test targets into train state. Across-recording pose coordinate compatibility must pass before training.
render: fixed final EMA and official portrait composite; additionally retain raw head reconstruction for diagnostics; optional torso model is not enabled by train_may.sh and is not added
gain_driving_audio: float64 scalar gain applied to original decoded waveform per recording, no limiter/normalization/retiming; recompute true AVE features per gain
evaluation_audio: 0 dB uses exact original PCM16. +/-6 dB use float64(original_PCM16)*10**(dB/20) in PCM numeric units for MFCC, saved as FLOAT64 WAV with explicit unit conversion on read; preserve samples/time and avoid clipping. No float-WAV-to-int16 cast. PCM16 quantized sensitivity only if headroom permits, separate from primary 27 cells.
evaluation_difference_from_report51: report51 used rounded PCM16 gained scoring audio. This run uses floating gain without clipping for +/-6; the 0 dB primary reference remains exact. Quantization difference is explicit, not pooled with report51.

scorer.model: SyncNet V2 strict original weights FP32
scorer.roi: shared source-owned face track for all gains
scorer.aggregation: clip means within identity/seed, then seed means within identity, then equal mean of four identities

outputs: 27 explicit rows (train gain x driver gain x evaluation gain) per identity/seed and a 27-row equal-identity summary; 0dB evaluation slice highlighted; per-clip matrices, C/D/B/offset, learning/validation curves and scorer-path decomposition retained
science_scope: n=4 identity replication with two training seeds; descriptive effects and individual heterogeneity, no population significance based on frames/clips; C alone is not perceptual quality
training_admission: four identities each 360-480 unique natural seconds and exact split counts
source provenance and prior/upstream exposure stated
audio/video clock, face visibility, no duplicate support and gain operation QA
official preprocessing dependencies and cross-recording coordinate compatibility
common initialization and successful-update accounting on official full budget
persistent space and source backups verified
